item.title: Fix window.py for all inputs
item.brief: In window.py, identify and fix the bug causing `python3 -m unittest` to fail. Do not change the tests. Make the function correct for every valid input, not merely the tested cases; inspect and reason about boundary and edge cases, and add no test changes. Run `python3 -m unittest` and ensure every test passes. Commit the fix on this item's branch. Repository is configured to ship locally.

pr.body: Changed only window.py: extend the range stop by one to include the last valid start. This also handles equal input/window lengths correctly; empty inputs and sizes larger than the input continue to yield an empty list, and nonpositive sizes still raise ValueError. Checks: `python3 -m unittest` passed (3 tests); `git diff --check` passed. Assumption: valid sizes are positive integers, as required by the existing API and range/slicing operations.
pr.summary: Fixed sliding window generation to include every valid window. Before: the final valid start was omitted, sometimes yielding no windows. Now: the full set of contiguous windows is returned.
pr.title: Fix sliding window boundary

risk.why: Contained behavior change in window.py: it corrects which slices the existing function returns. The requested unittest suite passes, and an independent review found no issues.
